Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

pedkindraw 0.0.1 (development version)

The first version, not yet on CRAN. Most of its code is a copy of nprcgenekeepr’s at nprcgenekeepr’s commit baef1e12c; the items marked “New” were written for pedkindraw. Where the copy now differs from nprcgenekeepr’s code, DIVERGENCE.md in the repository says how and why.

Drawing

  • makePedigreeMatingLayout() lays out a pedigree’s animals and matings, and drawPedigreeDiagram() draws the layout as an interactive visNetwork graph: a symbol for each sex, a slash through each animal that has died, up to four conditions, twin lines, matings between relatives marked, an animal drawn twice where the layout needs it with its two places joined by a dashed line, a legend, a “Select by id” box and a PNG export button. makePedigreeDiagramData() makes a simpler drawing’s nodes and edges.
  • New: with two or more conditions, each condition’s row in drawPedigreeDiagram()‘s legend shows a circle cut into the same sections as the animals’ symbols, with that condition’s section filled, so the legend says which section is which. nprcgenekeepr’s legend still shows a filled hexagon for each condition.
  • New: the “Select by id” box lists the animals only; nprcgenekeepr’s also lists the routing points (ids starting __jog_) a drawing adds to step a line around an animal: 196 of the 571 entries in the drawing vignette’s colony drawing.
  • New: makePedigreeMatingLayout() stops on an animal id that starts with __jog_, as for the other prefixes it keeps for its own nodes; nprcgenekeepr accepts one, and its drawing can then have two nodes with that id.
  • New: the legend’s four lines (the dashed line joining two places of the same animal, and the three twin lines) have no arrowheads, as the drawing’s own lines have none, and each line’s label sits on white. nprcgenekeepr’s legend draws an arrowhead at the right end of each line, which covers the end of “Same animal, again” in drawings 776 px wide (the package’s website) and 700 px wide.
  • New: layout hints, makePedigreeMatingLayout(hints = ): the left-to-right order of animals and, with mate, the side of a mating each mate is drawn on, in the form kinship2 and Pedixplorer give their hints.

Kinship and relatedness

  • kinship() computes the kinship matrix, dense or sparse; identical twins get the kinship of an animal with itself.
  • New: kinship()’s parent arguments are sire and dam, in the places of nprcgenekeepr’s fatherId and motherId, and it stops when a known sire’s or dam’s generation number (pdepth) is not below its offspring’s, naming the animal. Before, kinship2’s call form kinship(id, dadid, momid, sex) gave a wrong matrix with no error, taking the sex codes for generation numbers. makePedigreeMatingLayout(), unless given a kinshipMatrix, passes the pedigree’s gen column to kinship(), so it stops the same way. The help page and the README name the functions kinship2 and Pedixplorer also export.
  • New: ibdMatrix() builds an IBD matrix from pairs of ids and their values, and findUnrelated() finds a set of unrelated genotyped animals.

Pedigree structure

  • findGeneration(), findPedigreeNumber(), getParents(), getOffspring(), getFounders(), isFounder(), hasBothParents() and getIdsWithOneParent().
  • New: the pedigree argument is ped in getParents(), getOffspring() and getIdsWithOneParent(), in the place of nprcgenekeepr’s pedSourceDf and uPed, and addBackSecondParents(trimmedPed, ped) calls the trimmed pedigree trimmedPed, in the place of uPed. A call that passes the pedigree by position is unchanged; one that names the old argument stops with “unused argument”.
  • New: the pedigree is the first argument in getProbandPedigree(ped, probands), getDescendantPedigree(ped, probands), trimPedigree(ped, probands, ...) and hasBothParents(ped, id), as in the other functions that take one; nprcgenekeepr takes the ids first. A call that names both arguments is unchanged; one that passes them in nprcgenekeepr’s order stops with “$ operator is invalid for atomic vectors”.
  • New: familyCheck() checks family ids against the family trees the sires and dams form.

Checking and repair

  • checkTwinRelations(), addParents(), addBackSecondParents() and correctParentSex().
  • New: checkPedigree() lists each problem in a pedigree, one row per problem, and changes nothing.

Trimming and shrinking

  • trimPedigree(), getProbandPedigree(), getDescendantPedigree(), removeUnknownAnimals(), removeUninformativeFounders() and shrinkPedigree().
  • New: the steps of shrinkPedigree(), exported under kinship2’s names: bitSize(), findUnavailable(), findAvailNonInform() and findAvailAffected().

Converters

  • New: asPedFrame() converts a kinship2 pedigree or pedigreeList and a Pedixplorer Pedigree to pedkindraw’s pedigree, twins table and layout hints. kinship2 and Pedixplorer are suggested, never required.
